jssip-3.10.1.min.js
===================

Source:  JsSIP 3.10.1 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/jssip), MIT license.
Built:   locally with esbuild, 2026-09-08, because the published npm
         package ships no browser/UMD build at all -- its package.json
         has no "browser"/"unpkg"/"jsdelivr" field, only
         "main": "lib-es5/JsSIP.js" (a CommonJS entry point full of
         require() calls a <script> tag cannot run). Fetching any file
         out of the package via a CDN (jsdelivr, unpkg) returns that same
         CommonJS module, not something usable directly in a browser.

Build steps (reproducible):
    npm init -y
    npm install jssip@3.10.1 esbuild --no-save
    # entry.js:
    #   import * as JsSIP from 'jssip';
    #   window.JsSIP = JsSIP;
    npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife \
        --global-name=__JsSIP_UMD --outfile=jssip-bundle.min.js

Verified before vendoring: `node --check` (syntax), and a Node smoke test
with faked `window`/`navigator`/`document` globals confirming
`JsSIP.UA` / `JsSIP.WebSocketInterface` are real functions and
`JsSIP.version === '3.10.1'`.

To upgrade: bump the version in the npm install step above, rebuild, and
re-run the same verification before replacing this file.
